# Code of conduct

Lokit welcomes contributors of all backgrounds and experience levels.
These expectations apply to issues, pull requests, reviews, and other
project discussions.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and constructive, including when you disagree.
- Critique ideas and code without personal attacks.
- Welcome questions, accept feedback, and make room for different perspectives.
- Respect people's privacy and do not share personal information without consent.

Harassment, discrimination, threats, sexualized attention, and sustained
disruption of project discussions are not acceptable.

## Raising concerns

For concerns about public project interactions, notify
[@ciarandarby](https://github.com/ciarandarby) in the relevant discussion or
open an issue linking to the public interaction. Do not include private
information or repeat abusive material unnecessarily.

The maintainer may edit or remove inappropriate content, close disruptive
discussions, or restrict participation. Responses should reflect the severity
and context of the behavior and aim to keep the project welcoming.
